title: Shiva Shadow Lamp
description:
Witness the Magic of Devotion

At first glance, it looks like a beautifully textured, modern art piece. But the moment you switch on the light, the divine energy of Mahadev is revealed.

​This meticulously crafted Shiva Shadow Lamp uses the fascinating art of lithophanes—varying thicknesses in the material block the light just enough to create a breathtaking, highly detailed image of Lord Shiva. It is not just a lamp; it is an experience of peace and spirituality for your space.

​Why You’ll Love It:

​The Perfect Reveal: Watch the intricate details of Mahadev magically appear when illuminated.

​Premium Quality: Crafted with premium white PLA filament, ensuring the cleanest, most vibrant light diffusion and a durable, eco-friendly finish.

​High-Precision Art: Printed using top-tier 3D printing technology to capture every tiny detail of the divine design.

​Versatile Decor: The perfect size for your home mandir, bedside table, meditation corner, or desk.

​A Unique Gift: An unforgettable, personalized gift for Shiv Bhakts, housewarmings, Diwali, or any auspicious occasion.

​Product Specifications:

​Material: High-Quality, Eco-Friendly Premium White PLA

​Lighting: Includes a bright, energy-efficient LED base (warm white recommended for the best glow)

​Power: Battery

​Care Instructions: Wipe gently with a dry microfiber cloth. Keep away from direct, extreme heat.

​Shipping & Delivery:

​Locally Crafted: Proudly designed and 3D printed in Bengaluru.

​Pan-India Shipping: Securely packaged and shipped across India.

​Bengaluru Locals: Local pickup options are available at checkout!
